pages.text: The sun sank toward the edge of the sea. A white lighthouse stood on the hill.
They wanted to see the moment its light came on. "We must not miss that very moment."
Riri looked all around. Lolo ran toward the lighthouse. "We need a spot with a good view." "Just go closer."
Riri climbed onto a rock. A pine tree hid the top of the lighthouse.
Riri came down to the sand. This time, the hill hid the lighthouse.
Lolo stood right beneath the lighthouse and tilted their head far back.
Only a white wall was in sight. Lolo's neck grew stiff.
While changing spots, Riri bumped into Lolo. Thump! They tumbled onto the sand.
Lying down, they looked at the sky. Just then, the top of the lighthouse flashed!
The light circled, shining over the sea. Without getting up, they counted. "One... two... three..." The lighthouse kept turning.
